audit.whatIsWrong: Stage whys were the generic Lux template with male pronouns and never mentioned the only thing that decides this lane: the Pyromania charge count.
audit.why: Annie is female. Her passive stuns on the next offensive spell after four casts, and her longest reach is Disintegrate at 625 versus Lux's 1175 Q and 1100 E — so the lane is counting casts, not out-ranging her.
audit.corrected: Whys now count her casts and name Disintegrate's 625 range; pronouns corrected across tldr, winCon, phases, wave, bullets and report entries.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[0]='Lux', win[1]='Lux', win[4]='Annie'.
audit.why: The packet levelChart matches the content layer exactly, and the content prose describes Lux owning levels 1-2 and Annie spiking at 6 with Flash into a charged stun plus Summon: Tibbers (130s at rank 1, 600 range).
audit.corrected: phases[0].side and phases[1].side to Lux, phases[4].side to Annie; rows 2, 3, 5 and 6 stay Skill and already agree. Spikes: early range dominance, the level 6 stun-Tibbers window, the first-item skill check, late combo race.

audit.whatIsWrong: Molten Shield was never mentioned, and breakdown.cooldowns held no numbers.
audit.why: Molten Shield (10s, 800 range) shields her and damages anyone who strikes her, so it eats the front of a poke commit; Disintegrate is 4s and Incinerate 7s, which is how fast four casts charge the stun; R is 130/115/100 at only 600 range.
audit.corrected: tradeGood now forces Molten Shield out first; cooldowns carries R 130s, Q 4s, W 7s, E 10s and ties four casts to one charged stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text wrote 'Summon Tibbers'; two bullet bodies were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: The kit's R is 'Summon: Tibbers' with the colon; lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED on dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d.
audit.corrected: Ability name punctuated correctly; bullets rewritten to their own titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT: the cooldowns field carried no cooldown number.
audit.why: An earlier proposal targeted these same fields but its replacement text overshot the +/-10% length rule, so apply-proposals dropped the edit and the defect survived on disk.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to the same meaning inside the length budget, grounded in real ability names and cooldowns from champ-data/_kits: breakdown.cooldowns.
